**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User has a growing collection of vintage cameras.  
[FACT] User recently received a 1990s-era Nikon FM2 SLR camera.  
[EVENT] User won the Nikon FM2 SLR camera at an online auction for $120.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper storage and maintenance tips for the Nikon FM2 SLR camera include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Store the camera in a dry, cool place with minimal humidity (around 50-60% relative humidity).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Protect the camera from direct sunlight to avoid damage to materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid extreme temperatures; store away from heat sources and keep temperatures between 50°F (10°C) and 75°F (24°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a hard case or storage box specifically designed for cameras.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regularly clean the camera's exterior and interior with a soft, dry cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a small amount of silicone-based lubricant on the shutter blades and mirror damper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Check and clean the viewfinder with a soft brush or blower bulb.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ensure the battery compartment is clean and free of corrosion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Periodically test the camera to ensure it's functioning properly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include handling with care, using a lens cap, keeping the camera strap clean, documenting the camera's history, and considering climate-controlled storage.  
[FACT] User has set up a dedicated room for collectibles called the "nerd cave."  
[EVENT] User is looking for recommendations for display cases or shelves for their vintage camera collection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for display cases include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Glass-fronted display cases with UV-filtering glass or acrylic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Shadow box displays that can be hung on a wall or placed on a shelf.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Curio cabinets with multiple shelves and a glass or acrylic door.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for shelves include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Floating shelves with a smooth, matte finish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recessed shelves for a sleek, minimalist look.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tiered shelves with adjustable heights for displaying cameras of different sizes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for displaying cameras include grouping similar cameras together, using risers and stands, adding context with props, considering lighting, and keeping the display tidy.
